title: Cosmos Validation Catalogue row schema (v1)
description: One chain-verified self-validating row in the srmech cosmos_validation catalog. Each row encodes Planck-canonical Ω density parameters as rationals + a scale-factor value + the expected f_dark(a) ground-truth rational. CI runs the friedmann_dark_fraction 9-step chain and bit-exact-compares produced output to stored (expected_num, expected_den). Falsifies Spike #27 / PR #437 Q6.1 monotonicity claim per [[feedback_every_doc_edit_faces_falsification]].

row_type.description: Taxonomy. Initial rc10 ships only 'friedmann_ratio'; future rcs may add 'friedmann_derivative_sign', 'cpl_dark_envelope', etc.

a_num.description: Numerator of scale factor a = a_num/a_den. May be 0 only if a_den is nonzero.

expected_num.description: Ground-truth numerator of f_dark(a) reduced to lowest terms.

chain_id.description: Name of the operator chain that produces this row's output.

source_published_date.description: ISO 8601 publication date of the canonical SSoT (Planck 2018 VI).
